Test Case 1: DNS Resolution Test

Validates that DevBob service DNS can be resolved within the Kubernetes cluster.

Input:
- target: tcp://devbob.metabob.svc.cluster.local:8080
- testType: dns-resolution

Expected Output:
- resolvable: true (DNS name resolves to ClusterIP)
- usesServiceDNS: true (target uses k8s service DNS)
- notLocalhost: true (not using localhost)

Validation Method:
- Run nslookup from test pod in cluster
- Verify target format contains service DNS
- Confirm no localhost reference

Success Criteria:
- DNS resolves to valid ClusterIP
- Target format is correct
- No localhost/127.0.0.1 in target
